_provenance: Captured from a genuine openai-agents run: real Agent, real @function_tools, real Runner, real FuseRunHooks. Only the model's token generation was stubbed, so the EVENT STREAM is exactly what production emits - orderings, field population, and the adapter's convention of attaching progress to TOOL_RESULT rather than emitting STATE_UPDATE.
_honest_limitation: This validates the event SHAPE, not the failure distribution. The scenario itself is still one I designed, so it does not cure authoring bias. Traces from agents solving tasks nobody chose for their failure characteristics are what would.
